questions.question_en: Consider the following statements about the Governor's discretionary powers: 1. The Governor can reserve a state bill for consideration of the President at his/her own discretion. 2. The Governor cannot appoint a Chief Minister at his own discretion. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.topic: President, Vice-President, Prime Minister and Council of Ministers
questions.language_status: English structured extraction; Telugu not included in index
questions.explanation_en: Reworded from UPSC CSP 2014 Q60; the answer here follows this wording (option 1). Governor may reserve bill (Art 200); can appoint CM at discretion in hung house. Statement 1 is correct — the Governor can reserve a bill for the President. Statement 2 is incorrect — in situations where no party has a clear majority, the Governor can use discretion in appointing the CM.
questions.explanation_te: ఈ ప్రశ్న UPSC CSP 2014 Q60 నుంచి మార్చి రాసినది (reworded); ఇక్కడి జవాబు ఈ పాఠం ప్రకారమే (ఎంపిక 1). గవర్నర్ బిల్లును రాష్ట్రపతి పరిశీలనకు రిజర్వ్ (reserve) చేయగలరు; హంగ్ సభలో ముఖ్యమంత్రిని విచక్షణ (discretion)తో నియమించగలరు.
